answer: Like a forge that slowly tempers steel, the network forges each identity through a public, slow process no one can rush, and the heat leaves a unique temper mark no copy can fake. Each record then grows like a crystal, layer by layer, and a prism splits it into a spectrum of facets: work, attestations, connections. An honest crystal shows every color; farm crystals all share the same lattice and angles, so the prism reveals them as one cheap copy stamped many times. To pass, a farm must forge a distinct crystal for every sockpuppet, each slow and in the open - as expensive as honest work.
